title: TypeScript/Vite to JavaScript/Next.js recreation

assessment_snapshot.intro: The workspace contains an existing TypeScript/Vite bug-tracker application and a separate Next.js target scaffold, including:
bullets: The source includes dashboard, bug list/detail/create, analytics, settings, auth, landing, OAuth consent, and MCP setup screens.
Supabase client/auth and MCP integrations exist in the source workspace.
The target folder triage-bug-tracker already has Next.js 16.4.0, React 19.3.0, and Tailwind CSS 4 initialized.
The source includes shadcn/ui-style component files; no separate screenshot or design reference was supplied in the request.

proposed_outcome: Recreate the source application's frontend and backend behavior in JavaScript within the existing triage-bug-tracker Next.js project, preserving user-visible flows and existing integrations unless the answers below specify a different backend or data migration approach.
